The present petition has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in connection with FIR No. 276/2025 under Sections 420/120B/34 IPC registered at Police Station Jagatpuri.
2. Vide order dated 01.08.2025, notice was issued by this Court and further interim protection was granted to the petitioner subject to the petitioner joining investigation.
3. Mr. Anurag Jain, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he has joined investigation as and when called by the I.O concerned.
The said position is also affirmed by the I.O, who is present in Court.
4. Ms. Richa Dhawan, learned APP for the State, on instructions from the I.O, submits that the petitioner is not required for any further investigation.

5. In view of the above, it is directed that in the event of the petitioner's arrest, he may be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- and a surety bond of the like amount to the
This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 10/11/2025 at 21:45:58 satisfaction of the SHO/Investigating Officer / Arresting Officer subject to the following conditions:-
(i) The petitioner shall join investigation as and when directed by the I.O concerned.
( ii) The petitioner shall not influence the witnesses in any manner or try to contact the complainant or tamper with the evidence.
6. The petition stands disposed of.
